allow: PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { $c | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess; $c.OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { Get-Process -Id $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,ProcessName } } else { Write-Output "port 3000 free" })
